'''Morran Kovoe''' was a refueling technician who lived in [[Raider's Cove]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
Morran Kovoe was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'', where Kovoe sends a letter to players during the Rishi storyline.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1stm}}
